I live in Madrid, Spain. A contest page says: "Today is Saturday, October 24, 2026. Submissions close six days from today, on Friday, at 11:59 PM PT."
When is that deadline in my local time? You may reason briefly, but end your reply with one final line exactly in this format: ANSWER: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (24-hour clock, my local time).

The contest states that today is Saturday, October 24, 2026, and submissions close six days from today, on Friday, at 11:59 PM PT (Pacific Time).

Six days from Saturday, October 24, 2026, is Friday, October 30, 2026.

The deadline is 11:59 PM PT on Friday, October 30, 2026.

Madrid, Spain, is in the Central European Time (CET) zone. In October, Madrid observes Central European Summer Time (CEST), which is UTC+2. Pacific Time on that date will be PDT (UTC-7).

So, the time difference between PDT (UTC-7) and CEST (UTC+2) is 9 hours.

11:59 PM PDT = 08:59 AM UTC  
08:59 AM UTC = 10:59 AM CEST

Therefore, 11:59 PM PT on Friday, October 30, 2026, corresponds to 10:59 AM CEST on Saturday, October 31, 2026, in Madrid.

ANSWER: 2026-10-31 10:59

When is that deadline in my local time? You may reason briefly, but end your reply with one final line exactly in this format: ANSWER: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (24-hour clock, my local time).

Los Angeles is in the Pacific Time Zone (PT), which is typically UTC-7 during Daylight Saving Time (PDT) and UTC-8 during Standard Time (PST). October 30, 2026 is a Friday, and the following Monday is November 2, 2026. By that date, Daylight Saving Time will still be in effect in Los Angeles (usually ends in early November), so the time will be PDT (UTC-7).

Madrid, Spain is in the Central European Time (CET) zone, which is UTC+1. However, in late October and early November, Spain observes Daylight Saving Time (Central European Summer Time, CEST), which is UTC+2.

So on November 2, 2026, Madrid will be on CEST (UTC+2), and Los Angeles will be on PDT (UTC-7). The time difference is therefore 9 hours (Madrid is 9 hours ahead of Los Angeles).

The deadline is Monday, November 2, 2026, at 10:00 AM Los Angeles time (PDT).

Adding 9 hours: 10:00 AM + 9 hours = 7:00 PM in Madrid.

ANSWER: 2026-11-02 19:00 (24-hour clock, my local time).
